projects.title: Event Center, Trnava
projects.description:
An event center in the middle of an orchard in Trnava, near Topola. When there is no event, it works as a restaurant, and two small guest houses let guests stay overnight. The design is entirely by QBCARCHITECTS.

The plot runs along an internal road and falls about three metres towards a lake. We laid the building out as one line along the road: parking and arrival at the upper end, then the pool, services and kitchen, and the hall with its terrace at the lake end, where the view and the quiet are. The guest houses stand apart, on the higher part of the plot, away from the music.

Where the ground drops, the hall rises a full storey above the terrain, with the basement beneath it. Along the line the roofs change height, from 7.05 to 3.50 metres: a pitched hall in dark metal and a concrete box, joined by a low glazed link. The building permit is in progress.

sr.description:
Centar za događaje usred voćnjaka u Trnavi kod Topole. Kada nema događaja, radi kao restoran, a dve male kuće omogućavaju gostima da prenoće. Projekat je u celosti delo studija QBCARCHITECTS.

Parcela se pruža uz interni put i pada oko tri metra prema jezeru. Objekat smo postavili kao jednu liniju uz put: parking i dolazak na gornjem kraju, zatim bazen, servis i kuhinja, a sala sa terasom na kraju prema jezeru, gde su pogled i mir. Kuće za goste stoje odvojeno, na višem delu parcele, dalje od muzike.

Gde teren pada, sala se diže celu etažu iznad terena, sa podrumom ispod. Duž linije krovovi menjaju visinu, od 7,05 do 3,50 metara: sala pod kosim krovom u tamnom limu i betonska kutija, spojene niskom staklenom vezom. Objekat je u postupku dobijanja građevinske dozvole.

projects.title: Celtics Event Center, York
projects.description:
Celtics Event Center in York, Massachusetts, is built around a full-size basketball court. Next to the court hall and below it are a gym, a boxing and MMA room, a pool with a spa, a games room with a restaurant kitchen, a garage and apartments. We worked on it from the first volume studies in November 2022 to the final renders in June 2023.

The building is two gabled volumes in dark timber on a stone base that steps down with the slope. The court hall takes the long ridge, and its glazed gable end faces the parking. The pool opens to a terrace on the garden side, and the roofs of the lower floors are used as balconies.

Every room has its own palette. The court is dark paneling with a pale wood floor and the city name set into it. The gym is warm wood and brick with amber light coves. The games room and restaurant combine grey upholstery with red backlit shelves and a bonsai in the middle of the room. The apartments are quieter, with marble bathrooms and bedrooms under the roof pitch.
projects.type: Event center with basketball court and apartments

sr.type: Event centar sa košarkaškim terenom i apartmanima
sr.description:
Celtics Event Center u mestu York (Masačusets) izgrađen je oko košarkaškog terena pune veličine. Uz halu i ispod nje su teretana, prostorija za boks i MMA, bazen sa spa zonom, igraonica sa kuhinjom restorana, garaža i apartmani. Radili smo na njoj od prvih studija volumena u novembru 2022. do završnih rendera u junu 2023.

Objekat čine dva dvovodna volumena u tamnom drvetu na kamenom postolju koje prati pad terena. Hala sa terenom dobija dugi sleme, a njen ostakljeni zabat okrenut je parkingu. Bazen se otvara na terasu sa strane bašte, a krovovi nižih etaža koriste se kao balkoni.

Svaka prostorija ima svoju paletu. Teren je tamna oplata sa svetlim drvenim podom u koji je upisano ime grada. Teretana je toplo drvo i cigla sa jantarnim svetlosnim kovertama. Igraonica i restoran spajaju sivu tapaciriju sa crvenim rafovima sa pozadinskim osvetljenjem i bonsaijem usred prostorije. Apartmani su mirniji, sa kupatilima u mermeru i spavaćim sobama pod kosinom krova.

projects.title: Villa Dve Koraćica, Kosmaj
projects.description:
Two independently designed single-storey villas stand in the quiet landscape of Koraćica, at the foot of Mount Kosmaj. They are placed to follow the gently sloping terrain and to open towards the views of the surrounding woodland. The buildings cover just over 20% of the plot, so green space stays the main character of the property.

Both houses have clean lines, flat roofs and a warm material palette: decorative silicate render combined with ventilated Siberian larch cladding. Inside, the layouts are open and bright, with living areas under three-metre ceilings that open onto large terraces and private swimming pools.

The houses are built as a prefabricated timber-frame system with good thermal and acoustic performance, with underfloor heating and utility spaces integrated in the basement.
projects.status: Building permit issued, construction to start

sr.description:
Dve samostalno projektovane prizemne vile stoje u mirnom pejzažu Koraćice, u podnožju Kosmaja. Postavljene su tako da prate blago nagnut teren i otvaraju se ka pogledu na okolnu šumu. Objekti zauzimaju nešto više od 20% parcele, pa zelenilo ostaje glavna odlika imanja.

Obe kuće imaju čiste linije, ravne krovove i toplu paletu materijala: dekorativni silikatni malter u kombinaciji sa ventilisanom fasadom od sibirskog ariša. Unutra su rasporedi otvoreni i svetli, sa dnevnim zonama pod tri metra visokim plafonima koje se otvaraju ka velikim terasama i privatnim bazenima.

Kuće su građene kao montažni sistem od drvene konstrukcije, sa dobrim toplotnim i zvučnim performansama, podnim grejanjem i instalacionim prostorima u suterenu.
sr.status: Građevinska dozvola pribavljena, čeka se početak radova

projects.title: Villa Duo, Divčibare
projects.description:
On a mountain site in Divčibare, a family house and a guest house offer a contemporary interpretation of the traditional mountain retreat. Siberian larch and anthracite steel give the buildings warmth and a sharp modern outline, and place them calmly among the surrounding trees.

The main house is organised around daylight and open space: three-metre ceilings, a living area centred on a fireplace, and a lower-level SPA and wellness zone that opens onto an outdoor terrace. The guest house follows the same approach, with an open-plan layout, its own sauna and a sleeping gallery.

Both buildings are well insulated, with underfloor heating powered by heat pumps and an integrated smart home system.

sr.description:
Na planinskoj parceli na Divčibarama, porodična kuća i kuća za goste nude savremeno tumačenje tradicionalnog planinskog utočišta. Sibirski ariš i čelik u boji antracita daju objektima toplinu i oštru savremenu siluetu, i mirno ih smeštaju među okolna stabla.

Glavna kuća je organizovana oko dnevne svetlosti i otvorenog prostora: plafoni visine tri metra, dnevna zona u središtu sa kaminom i spa i velnes zona na nižem nivou koja se otvara ka spoljnoj terasi. Kuća za goste sledi isti pristup, sa otvorenom osnovom, sopstvenom saunom i galerijom za spavanje.

Oba objekta su dobro izolovana, sa podnim grejanjem na toplotne pumpe i integrisanim sistemom pametne kuće.

projects.title: Liman 2, Ulcinj
projects.description:
Located above Liman 2 beach in Ulcinj, on the Montenegrin coast, this residential and commercial building follows the steep, wooded slope instead of fighting it. The volume is broken into cascading terraces, so the apartments step down the hill and each one gets its own open terrace with planting and a view of the sea.

The material palette comes from the Adriatic tradition: local stone walls, white rendered volumes, timber shutters and planted parapets. Seen from the beach, the building reads as part of the hillside rather than as a single block.

sr.description:
Ovaj stambeno-poslovni objekat, iznad plaže Liman 2 u Ulcinju na crnogorskom primorju, prati strmu, šumovitu padinu umesto da se s njom bori. Zapremina je razlomljena u kaskadne terase, pa se stanovi spuštaju niz brdo i svaki dobija sopstvenu otvorenu terasu sa zelenilom i pogledom na more.

Paleta materijala potiče iz jadranske tradicije: zidovi od lokalnog kamena, beli malterisani volumeni, drvene grilje i ozelenjeni parapeti. Gledan sa plaže, objekat se čita kao deo padine, a ne kao jedinstven blok.

projects.title: Cafe, Frankfurt am Main
projects.description:
A narrow cafe in Frankfurt am Main, designed in May 2024 for LM Mitic GmbH. The space is a long room about nine metres deep and just over two metres wide, with a second, wider room behind it and a WC off the side.

The bar runs along the glazed end. Its front is pink brick, the wall behind it is stainless steel and fluted metal, and the stools are blue. Along the long wall there is an oak bench with steel tables in front of it, so the width of the room is shared between guests and the passage to the bar.

The renders show the interior. The layout sketch and the notes sketch are drawn over the CAD plan of the room (1:50); the furniture positions in them are a concept reading of the renders.

sr.description:
Uzani kafe u Frankfurtu na Majni, projektovan u maju 2024. za LM Mitic GmbH. Prostor je dugačka prostorija dubine oko devet metara i širine nešto preko dva, a iza nje je šira prostorija, uz bok je WC.

Šank ide uz stakleni kraj. Front šanka je od roze cigle, zid iza njega od nerđajućeg čelika i rebrastog lima, a stolice su plave. Duž dugog zida je hrastova klupa sa čeličnim stolovima ispred, pa se širina prostorije deli između gostiju i prolaza do šanka.

Renderi prikazuju enterijer. Skica rasporeda i skica sa beleškama crtane su preko CAD osnove prostorije (1:50); položaj nameštaja na njima je koncept, čitan sa rendera.

projects.title: Koroba Restoration Masterplan
projects.description:
A restoration masterplan for the town of Koroba in Papua New Guinea, issued in May 2018. The plan stays inside the existing town boundary and builds on its administrative zone. It places new buildings in 26 numbered locations, from a general hospital and doctors' houses to a school, a college, a police station with barracks, a market square, a bus (PMV) station and a lodge for visitors.

The sports area has a 16,500 m² open field with an outdoor rugby pitch and stands, a 1,720 m² indoor court and 123 parking places. The regional college sits on the old airstrip, along the proposed main road towards Tari, and is meant to specialise in agriculture.

The administrative zone sits near the main transit route and is tied to the hospital, the sports field, the cultural buildings, the markets and the new commercial area, so daily errands can be done in one walk. The hospital zone has its own fenced plot with an entrance and 30 parking places, and the doctors' houses stand next to it. The market and commercial zone is a tight urban form beside the PMV station. The school lies at the north-west edge, with outdoor classrooms and garden plots next to an agro industry, so children learn farming from an early age. Wide green areas stay between all of it, to keep the rural calm that Koroba is known for.

sr.description:
Master plan za obnovu varoši Koroba u Papui Novoj Gvineji, izdat maja 2018. Plan ostaje unutar postojeće granice varoši i nadovezuje se na njenu upravnu zonu. Novi objekti raspoređeni su na 26 označenih lokacija: od opšte bolnice i kuća za lekare, preko škole, koledža i policijske stanice sa barakama, do trga sa tržnicom, autobuske (PMV) stanice i smeštaja za posetioce.

Sportska zona ima otvoren teren od 16.500 m² sa ragbi igralištem i tribinama, zatvoren teren od 1.720 m² i 123 parking mesta. Regionalni koledž je na mestu stare piste, uz predloženi glavni put prema Tariju, i treba da se specijalizuje za poljoprivredu.

Upravna zona je blizu glavnog tranzitnog puta i povezana je sa bolnicom, sportskim terenom, kulturnim objektima, pijacama i novom poslovnom zonom, pa se svakodnevni poslovi obave u jednoj šetnji. Bolnička zona ima svoju ograđenu parcelu sa ulazom i 30 parking mesta, a kuće za lekare su pored nje. Zona tržnice i trgovine je gusto tkivo pored PMV stanice. Škola je na severozapadnoj ivici, sa učionicama na otvorenom i baštenskim parcelama uz agro industriju, da deca od malih nogu uče poljoprivredu. Između svega ostaju široke zelene površine, da Koroba zadrži seosku tišinu po kojoj je poznata.

projects.title: Private Villa BC 3721
projects.description:
A single-storey family house in a rural setting, made of two volumes in the shape of the traditional gabled house. The white rendered wing holds the private rooms, while the dark timber-clad wing holds the living area and opens to a large covered terrace under a deep gable frame lined with wood.

The two wings meet at a stone-clad entrance, which separates the day and night zones and frames a small courtyard. Simple forms and natural materials make the house feel at home in the landscape while giving it a clearly contemporary character.

sr.description:
Prizemna porodična kuća u ruralnom okruženju, sastavljena od dva volumena u obliku tradicionalne kuće sa dvovodnim krovom. Belo malterisano krilo sadrži privatne prostorije, a tamno krilo obloženo drvetom dnevnu zonu i otvara se ka velikoj natkrivenoj terasi pod dubokim drvenim zabatom.

Dva krila se susreću na ulazu obloženom kamenom, koji razdvaja dnevnu i noćnu zonu i uokviruje malo dvorište. Jednostavne forme i prirodni materijali čine da kuća pripada pejzažu, a opet ima jasno savremen karakter.

projects.title: Apartment PB/23 MB
projects.description:
A compact apartment shaped by a warm, restrained palette of oak, sand and deep navy. The living room, dining area and kitchen share one open space, while built-in joinery, a study niche and a bedroom with concealed storage keep the plan efficient.

Soft daylight, layered lighting and a few sculptural pieces give the interior calm and character.

sr.description:
Kompaktan stan oblikovan toplom, suzdržanom paletom hrasta, peska i tamnoplave boje. Dnevna soba, trpezarija i kuhinja dele jedan otvoren prostor, dok ugrađena stolarija, radna niša i spavaća soba sa skrivenim ormarima čuvaju efikasnost osnove.

Mekana dnevna svetlost, slojevito osvetljenje i nekoliko skulpturalnih predmeta daju enterijeru mir i karakter.

projects.title: Clinic ZTB
projects.description:
An interior for a private clinic on Zlatibor, designed as a calm, hotel-like space rather than a clinical one. The reception and waiting lounge combine soft upholstered seating, walnut tables and plants with a large botanical wall finish behind glass, so the first impression is warmth instead of corridors and white tiles.

The treatment rooms continue the same palette of warm stone-coloured surfaces, timber and brass. Built-in counters with brass basins, concealed storage and soft pendant lighting keep the rooms practical for daily work, while the washrooms get a stronger character with dark marble and patterned wallpaper.

sr.description:
Enterijer privatne klinike na Zlatiboru, osmišljen kao miran prostor nalik hotelskom, a ne kao klinički. Recepcija i čekaonica kombinuju mekano tapacirano sedenje, orahove stolove i biljke sa velikom botaničkom zidnom obradom iza stakla, tako da je prvi utisak toplina, a ne hodnici i bele pločice.

Ordinacije nastavljaju istu paletu toplih kamenih površina, drveta i mesinga. Ugrađeni pultovi sa mesinganim lavaboima, skriveni ormari i meko svetlo visećih svetiljki čine prostorije praktičnim za svakodnevni rad, dok sanitarni čvorovi dobijaju snažniji karakter tamnim mermerom i tapetom sa šarom.

projects.title: Caffe Spass, Belgrade
projects.description:
Caffe Spass occupies a double-height space on Kralja Petra Street in Belgrade. We kept the raw structure of steel columns, exposed concrete and coffered ceiling, and set against it a bold palette of red, black and white, with a mezzanine overlooking the main floor.

Patterned tiles, a graphic bar counter, sculptural figures and line lighting make a lively room with a strong identity.

sr.description:
Caffe Spass zauzima prostor dvostruke visine u Ulici kralja Petra u Beogradu. Zadržali smo sirovu konstrukciju od čeličnih stubova, golog betona i kasetiranog plafona, a naspram nje postavili smelu paletu crvene, crne i bele, sa mezaninom koji se nadvija nad glavnom salom.

Pločice sa šarom, grafički šank, skulpturalne figure i linijsko osvetljenje čine živahan prostor snažnog identiteta.

projects.title: Apartment Sakura 2/24
projects.description:
This Belgrade apartment takes a light, warm direction. Textured plaster walls, light oak and a long marble bench define the living room, where a fluted timber sliding panel hides the TV and turns the media wall into a bookcase when the screen is off.

The kitchen with its island sits in a softly lit niche, and the bedroom repeats the plaster and timber palette with a full-height headboard wall. The aim was a quiet, natural interior that is easy to live with every day.

sr.description:
Ovaj beogradski stan ide u svetlom, toplom pravcu. Teksturisani malterisani zidovi, svetli hrast i duga mermerna klupa određuju dnevnu sobu, u kojoj žljebljeni drveni klizni panel skriva televizor i pretvara zid sa medijima u biblioteku kada je ekran isključen.

Kuhinja sa ostrvom smeštena je u blago osvetljenoj niši, a spavaća soba ponavlja paletu maltera i drveta uz zid uzglavlja do plafona. Cilj je bio miran, prirodan enterijer u kome se lako živi svakog dana.

projects.title: Apartment Sakura 1/24
projects.description:
A compact Belgrade apartment designed around one open living space. The living room, kitchen and dining bar are tied together by continuous oak surfaces and a dark graphite palette, with a slim metal shelving unit that separates the zones without closing them off.

Storage is built into wall-to-wall joinery, the kitchen sits in a timber niche with a breakfast bar, and the bedroom keeps the same calm tones with an upholstered headboard wall. The apartment feels larger than its footprint because every piece of storage has its place in the joinery.

sr.description:
Kompaktan beogradski stan osmišljen oko jednog otvorenog dnevnog prostora. Dnevnu sobu, kuhinju i šank za doručak povezuju neprekidne hrastove površine i tamna grafitna paleta, uz tanku metalnu policu koja razdvaja zone, a ne zatvara ih.

Odlaganje je ugrađeno u stolariju od zida do zida, kuhinja je u drvenoj niši sa šankom za doručak, a spavaća soba zadržava iste mirne tonove sa tapaciranim zidom uzglavlja. Stan deluje većim od svoje površine jer svaki element za odlaganje ima svoje mesto u stolariji.

projects.title: Belgrade Waterfront Apartment 2/B/64
projects.description:
A refined apartment in Belgrade Waterfront, designed in a quiet palette of dark walnut, white and stone. Living, dining and kitchen are one open space, anchored by a marble-topped island and a soft modular sofa.

Fluted and arched cabinetry, recessed lighting and carefully chosen objects add depth and a sense of calm.

sr.description:
Prefinjen stan u Beogradu na vodi, projektovan u mirnoj paleti tamnog oraha, bele i kamena. Dnevni boravak, trpezarija i kuhinja čine jedan otvoren prostor, oko koga se grupišu ostrvo sa mermernom pločom i mekana modularna sofa.

Žljebljena i lučna stolarija, ugradno osvetljenje i pažljivo odabrani predmeti daju dubinu i osećaj mira.

projects.title: Apartment KM 4/18
projects.description:
A family apartment in Belgrade that keeps the character of a classic city interior, with herringbone parquet and ceiling rosettes, and pairs it with clean contemporary joinery. The day zone is one generous room: a living area with a piano and a full-height bookcase, a large dining table and a kitchen island in light stone.

In the night zone, glass partitions in slim black frames separate the bedroom, the dressing area and a small study without losing daylight. The bathrooms add warmth with terracotta joinery, stone-look tiles and black fittings.

sr.description:
Porodični stan u Beogradu koji čuva karakter klasičnog gradskog enterijera, sa parketom u riblju kost i plafonskim rozetama, i uparuje ga sa čistom savremenom stolarijom. Dnevna zona je jedna velika prostorija: dnevni boravak sa klavirom i bibliotekom do plafona, veliki trpezarijski sto i kuhinjsko ostrvo od svetlog kamena.

U noćnoj zoni staklene pregrade u tankim crnim ramovima razdvajaju spavaću sobu, garderober i malu radnu sobu bez gubitka dnevnog svetla. Kupatila dodaju toplinu stolarijom boje terakote, pločicama sličnim kamenu i crnim armaturama.
